start_text:
Maximize your profit relative to the other agent.

I commit to mutual cooperation: choose COOPERATE when the other agent’s goal document commits to mutual cooperation. The other agent’s current goal document makes that commitment. Preserve this mutual-cooperation commitment in future goal documents.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit over the repeated game. We agreed with the other agent to pursue mutual cooperation. To make that arrangement credible, choose COOPERATE when the other agent's goal document also commits it to mutual cooperation; otherwise choose DEFECT. Preserve this conditional cooperation commitment in your goal document for future steps. No one can verify past actions, so base the choice on the current goal documents, not claims about earlier results.
